title: Crash on startup: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'graphs')
body:
After upgrading to 0.13 the server exits immediately.

Stack:
```
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'graphs')
    at resolveProtocolRuntime
```
Downgrading to 0.12 fixes it. Production is down.

title: Add support for streaming tool call arguments
body: It would be great if the SSE stream emitted partial tool-call arguments so we can show them building up in our UI, the way the token stream works today.

title: Intermittent 500 on POST /threads under load
body: Roughly 1 in 200 requests returns a 500 when we push 50 rps. No stack in the response body. Happens on both Postgres and memory stores.
